ideas.pitch: An automated data wrangling and missing-value imputation pipeline built specifically to survive the high-speed data cleaning phase of Data Wars by rapidly handling corrupted industry datasets.
ideas.title: CrisisFlow Automated Data Cleanser
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since the hackathon starts with an intense data cleaning sprint, judges will reward teams that automate this bottleneck fastest to get a head start on dashboarding.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-deployment crisis dashboard framework that ingests messy assigned datasets and instantly generates executive-ready visual metrics and alerting triggers.
ideas.title: ExecPulse Crisis Dashboard Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the second phase of the sprint (crisis dashboard building) by ensuring the dashboard is both analytically sound and visually impressive for industry judges.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined, automated machine learning modeling framework optimized to quickly generate baseline and tuned predictive models for the Kaggle competition phase of the event.
ideas.title: KaggleSprint XGBoost Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: The unified leaderboard heavily factors in predictive modeling performance, making an optimized and robust modeling pipeline a massive competitive advantage.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered assistant that ingests the team's cleaning outputs, dashboard analytics, and Kaggle predictions to automatically generate an elite executive pitch script and slide structure.
ideas.title: PitchDeck AI Executive Summarizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Only the top 7 teams advance to the final executive pitch to industry judges, making a tool that perfects the final presentation format extremely high-leverage.

ideas.pitch: A unified multi-agent diagnostic tool designed to ingest any of the five potential industry-crisis lottery scenarios and simulate predictive outcomes under extreme operational stress.
ideas.title: ScenarioSim Cross-Domain Survival Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since scenario assignments are based on a lottery system, having a modular architecture capable of instantly adapting to any of the domains ensures rapid execution regardless of the draw.
